positions_full.usage: Volle Details: Trade-Bäume, Entry, letzte Trades.

modus.intro: Paper vs. Live, Gate-API, Dry-Run und Positionslimits.

dryrun.usage: Enhanced Dry Run: Sim-Wallet, Trending-Watchlist (wenn aktiviert).

sandbox_promote.usage: Erfolgreiche Strategie übernehmen. Danach nur ID.

onboarding_help.title: 🚀 Onboarding — Neue User (nur Operator)
onboarding_help.body: Als Operator onboardest du neue User — Paper auf Staging ohne Gate-Keys. Schnell (Henry & Co.): /onboard henry Optional Henrys Chat-ID: /onboard henry 123456789 Oder als Nachricht: henry Gemeinsamer Bot (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN) — kein @BotFather nötig. Gate API Key/Secret: optional (erst für Live später). Automatisch: Tenant, balanced-Profil, Watchlist BTC/ETH/SOL/PEPE, Welcome-Nachricht. Live später (optional): eigener Bot-Token + Gate Keys — interaktiv via /onboard (skip = Paper). Nur privat + Operator (TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID).

onboarding_help.title: 🚀 Onboarding — New users (operator only)
onboarding_help.body: As operator you can onboard new users with a single private message. 1. User preparation • Create their own bot via @BotFather • Provide Bot-Token + Gate.io API Key + Secret 2. Onboard (you) Just send the data as a normal private message: max 123456:AAH...BOTTOKEN... GATEKEY123... GATESECRET456... Or with labels (also 3 lines without name → auto ID): token: 123... key: GATE... secret: SEC... Automatically happens: • Tenant created (ID auto-generated if omitted) • Watchlist pre-seeded with BTC, ETH, SOL, PEPE • Webhook registered for the new bot • Welcome message sent directly into the user's own bot • Confirmation to you with the exact webhook URL Important: Only works in private chat with you (TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID). All sensitive data is encrypted. Alternative: /onboard (interactive or one-shot).
